title: Rabbi Joey Soffer: Mesilat Yesharim class #15

chapters.title: Examples of Truthfulness
chapters.about: merchant story,Shabbat,three scenarios to lie,pillars of the world

summary: Rabbi Soffer continues studying Mesilat Yesharim, focusing on the character traits of avoiding hatred and revenge, keeping one's word, and staying away from falsehood. He reads and explains the relevant sources and discusses how a person's behavior reflects on Hashem.
